name: Cheech & Chong - Eighth - Low Rider
description:
Indoor-grown, hand-trimmed, top-shelf. The Cheech & Chong Low Rider eighth delivers 3.5 grams of premium indoor flower — dense, frosty, and cured for full flavor and a smooth, even burn.

Low Rider brings a deep, laid-back profile: rich earthy and woody notes up front, layered with a sweet, subtly fruity edge and a smooth, gassy finish. Dense, resin-coated buds with a heavy nose and the kind of slow-burning character that rewards taking your time.

Why you'll love it:

3.5G premium indoor flower — grown in a controlled environment for consistent quality
Hand-trimmed and properly cured — dense, frosty buds with a smooth, even burn
Signature Low Rider flavor — rich earth and wood with sweet fruit and a gassy finish
Full terpene expression — rich aroma and flavor straight from the jar
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Premium flower, real flavor, and top-shelf quality in every eighth. Cheech & Chong Low Rider is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
